description: This file contains the implementation of a Database Abstraction Layer (ADODB) driver for ODBC in PHP, including classes for database connection and record set management specific to ODBC.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc
classes.description: A class representing the ODBC database connection, providing methods for connecting, executing queries, transaction management, and metadata retrieval specific to ODBC databases.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc
classes.description: A class representing a record set retrieved via ODBC, with methods to fetch and navigate through query results.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using ODBC with the given Data Source Name, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database using ODBC.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information, primarily the server version, from the connected ODBC database.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new database sequence (table) for generating sequential IDs.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops an existing sequence table.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID using a sequence, with basic concurrency control.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message encountered during database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number encountered during database operations.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tables from the database.

methods.name: ODBCTypes
methods.description: Maps ODBC data type integers to shorthand type codes.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, with optional input binding.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, with support for input parameter arrays.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB column in a table with new data.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.
